thread.title: The S&P 500 Looks Like It's About to Collapse, Hints These Data

author: thestreet.com
title: The S&P 500 Looks Like It's About to Collapse, Hints These Data
text:
Silly bulls.
Exuberance returned to Wall Street trading screens  on Monday after a brutal three-day selloff late last week. Apparently, investors are suddenly OK with the prospect of a U.S. trade war with China, Facebook's ( FB ) data breach means nothing to the broader FAANG (Facebook, Amazon ( AMZN ) , Apple ( AAPL ) , Netflix ( NFLX ) and Alphabet ( GOOGL ) ) space and the Federal Reserve is still a friend of the market. 
If you are lightening quick to believe all that stuff, we have a flying Tesla ( TSLA ) to sell you for $1. 
"The trend is weakening with the S&P 500 closing below rising 13, 26, and 40-week moving averages last week -- the lack of upside follow-through for the S&P 500 given new highs for the U.S. most active and S&P 500 advance/decline line is a concern," points out strategists at Bank of America Merrill Lynch. "The Volume Intensity Model has flipped bearish along with the % of NYSE stocks above 200-day moving averages as the breakdown in the 28-week Williams %R suggests an undercut of the 2532 low."
In other words, it would be wise to consider the multitude of bearish indicators in the market right now after the latest rout. You can see some of those below.
